description: Curated associations that let canonical model pages surface substantive model-specific research without duplicating it. Entries are navigational associations, not evidence claims.

eligibility_policy.qualifies_when: At least one substantive model- or family-specific research chapter, lineage packet, evidence dossier, or equivalent investigation adds material beyond the canonical facts and Report Card.
eligibility_policy.does_not_qualify: A generic profile paragraph, canonical facts alone, or a Report Card alone is not enough.
eligibility_policy.family_rule: A shared family chapter may support sibling hubs only when wording stays model-specific and no sibling hardware, score, capability, or dependency claim is inherited.
